recognize_zh: 抹片中成群的中大型細胞，核呈卵圓或腎形、部分有核溝、胞質淡嗜酸；切片骨小樑間有浸潤，CD1a 呈強膜陽性、S100 核與胞質陽性，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH），「口渴的孩子」提示尿崩症。
features: Aspirate/touch smear: clusters of medium to large cells with oval, reniform or folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional nuclear grooves; admixed small lymphocytes and background debris
Biopsy (H&E): cellular infiltrate occupying space between bony/cartilaginous trabeculae, with admixed inflammatory cells
CD1a: strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining of the lesional histiocytes
S100: nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in many lesional cells
describe_en: The aspirate smear shows cohesive clusters of medium to large histiocytic cells with oval to reniform, occasionally grooved nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm, with admixed inflammatory cells. The biopsy shows an infiltrate of similar cells between trabeculae accompanied by mixed inflammatory cells. The lesional cells are strongly positive for CD1a and S100. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; in a polyuric child this raises concern for multisystem disease with pituitary/hypothalamic involvement causing diabetes insipidus.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large with emperipolesis, S100-positive but CD1a- and langerin-negative.
Xanthogranulomatous histiocytes are foamy or Touton giant cells expressing CD68/CD163/factor XIIIa and lack CD1a and langerin.
Reactive histiocytes lack nuclear grooves and are CD1a-negative, with a neutrophil-rich infiltrate.
LC sarcoma shows marked atypia, frequent mitoses and high Ki-67 despite the same CD1a/S100 phenotype.
